patch.value: Enforce predeclared causal evaluation plans at promotion
Declare target populations, correlation units, sample sizes and fixed stopping rules before experiments. Bind plan identity and clustered observations to comparison and generation promotion.

Synthetic correlated cohorts cannot masquerade as independent samples; changed plans invalidate comparison identity. Typed SDK and CLI; compact TOON/JSON; typed refusals with remedies; README and example; non-git real public-tracker validation; npm and Bun CI release gates.

This item adds reusable immutable plan/comparison enforcement and cluster-aware promotion, stacked on PR #94; must merge after #94. Dependency pins remain unchanged.
